obstacle.reason: Deleting a wrong value removes the fact without restoring the right one. The gesture needed is to SET, and deletion cannot express it.
obstacle.reason_fr: Supprimer une valeur fausse retire le fait sans rétablir le bon. Le geste qu'il faudrait est d'ÉCRIRE, et la suppression ne sait pas l'exprimer.
obstacle.source: derived from what a deletion-only repair can express, read in the repairer's own code — its solution is a set of elements to delete and carries no insertion — together with the measurement of 2026-09-10. Per damage class, not per form.
